rationale: Third-party injury (neighbor's child) occurring on the policyholder's premises due to alleged unsafe condition (icy walkway).
claim_summary: Neighbor's 9-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on the policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. This is a pediatric injury requiring immediate adjuster investigation and assessment of premises liability.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: neighbor's child slipped on icy walkway and fell
